headline: Seven years of receipts, one page
body: The archive is open. Every season back to 2019 is in here — champions, records, points for and against, and where each of you finished every single year.

Some of it does not flatter anyone. Abel, Shuman and Kneeland have each played seven seasons and finished 51-45. Identical records. Zero championships between the three of them. Meanwhile bo is 42-41 with two rings.

Kneeland owns the best season anyone has ever had here — 1,803 points in 2021 — and finished fourth. Shuman went 11-3 in 2023 with the second-highest total on record and finished fourth. There is a pattern and it is not a kind one.
Pick your name from the dropdown up top to see your own dossier. Rule vote closes at the draft.
